The way renters discover apartment communities is changing.

The SocialDM Research & Insights explores how social media, Google Search, Google Maps, local content, competitive market conditions, and AI powered search are shaping multifamily marketing and apartment discovery.

Our research is informed by real world work with apartment communities and lease ups across competitive markets, alongside ongoing search, local visibility, and AI discovery analysis through LocalLift™.

The 2026 Multifamily Visibility Report

How Apartment Communities and Lease Ups Are Being Discovered Across Social Media, Google Search, Google Maps, and AI Search

Apartment discovery no longer happens in one place.

Renters move between social media, Google Search, Google Maps, apartment listing sites, reviews, local content, short form video, and AI powered search experiences when deciding where to live.

The 2026 Multifamily Visibility Report examines how these discovery channels work together, why some apartment communities become easier to find than others, and what multifamily marketers should understand about visibility in an increasingly fragmented renter journey.
